# Description

Please include a clear summary of the changes made.

# Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (new functionality / animation / game)
- [ ] Refactor (code improvement without changing functionality)
- [ ] Performance (optimization of FPS, assets, or bundle)

# Checklist

- [ ] Code compiles correctly (`pnpm build`).
- [ ] Verified in local development (`pnpm dev`).
- [ ] Visual performance verified (GSAP / Three.js / Lenis running smoothly).
